prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
(none yet)

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 89.9%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 80.0%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 69.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 26.5%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Spotlight Desktop Pet Adoption Preview Redesign: Redesign the friend selection screen using a spotlight layout with animated previews showing pets interacting directly on a desktop background. (why: Adoption conversion drops to 69.9% with a high mean time of 1017s, indicating users hesitate when picking their pet companion.)
1: [sign_in, hint] Existing Account Pet Recovery Sign-In Hint: Add a visual hint on the sign-in screen prompting users to sign in with their original provider to prevent pet resets. (why: The top support theme (8 emails) is pets missing or reset after signing in again under duplicate accounts.)
2: [choose_path, layout] Split Screen Path Selector with Story Preview: Switch the path selection layout to a split view displaying a quick visual comparison between instant presets and custom creation. (why: Path selection has an extreme mean time of 514s despite an 8s median, showing a tail of stuck users who need clearer path comparisons.)
3: [adoption, new_screen] Custom Pet Generation Diagnostic Helper Screen: Add a new screen after photo upload that runs a rapid preview diagnostic to catch visual glitches before finalizing adoption. (why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet creation failing or resulting in visual distortion.)
4: [finish, redesign] Desktop Mascot Welcome & Controls Summary Redesign: Redesign the home_intro screen to spotlight layout featuring an animated mascot demonstrating where the pet lives on the screen. (why: Finish completion drops to 64.8% (mean time 5815s) and users complain that pets do not show up on desktop or are hard to find.)
5: [adoption, copy] Adoption Certificate Account Sync Protection Copy: Update adoption certificate copy to emphasize that pet ownership records are permanently tied to the user account. (why: 8 support emails complained about missing or lost pets after re-authenticating.)
6: [sign_in, wait_info] Sign-In Loading Timeout Fallback Notice: Add a fallback retry notice component on the sign-in screen if sign-in providers fail to load promptly. (why: 2 support emails specifically reported that the sign-in screen fails to appear or stalls completely.)
7: [sign_in, reorder] Post-Adoption Sign-In Order Shift: Move sign-in step to occur immediately after pet selection and photo upload, right before the waiting screen. (why: Sign-in conversion is 80.0% upfront, but allowing users to design and adopt their pet first increases commitment before demanding authentication.)
